articles.title: Infantino sorry for errors but stays Fifa president
articles.summary: Gianni Infantino will remain as Fifa president after receiving the backing of senior executives, but "sincerely apologises" for errors made in his controversial private investment plans.

articles.title: Key questions as Infantino faces Fifa executives
articles.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino will face senior leaders of football's world governing body on Wednesday. This is what is expected to happen.

articles.title: Parkinson gets England-U20s call before World Cup
articles.summary: Midfielder Erica Meg Parkinson, 18, has been named in England's preparation squad for the Under-20 Women's World Cup in Poland next month.
